title: Clone payoff bounds
statement: In a weighted constraint experiment, fix a positive integer $M$, an assignment of values to variable-clone pairs, an outcome, and a choice of one clone for each query position of that outcome. The payoff, equal to $1$ when the selected predicate is satisfied by the assigned values and $0$ otherwise, lies in $[0,1]$.
hypotheses_covered: An assignment of values to variable-clone pairs is given
A clone is chosen for each query position
